candidates.name: Keeping our fundamental benchmarks in order
verified_facts: Fundamental Benchmarks are the physical realisation of Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
ODN is based on mean sea level observed at Newlyn, Cornwall, during 1915-1921.
FBM heights relative to ODN were determined through a network of precise levelling lines.
semantic_limits: A benchmark datum reference defines the vertical reference system; it does not prove the elevation value of a parcel raster cell without source-specific raster lineage.

candidates.name: Search for benchmarks - OS legacy control data
verified_facts: OS benchmarks record height above Ordnance Datum.
Height differences between benchmarks were established by spirit levelling.
OS identifies ODN as the national height system for mainland Great Britain.
The legacy benchmark archive is no longer maintained.
semantic_limits: Legacy benchmark records are vertical-datum context and must not be treated as current parcel elevation observations or silently substituted for LiDAR measurements.
